name: speech-cpp
description: Umbrella port over the QVAC speech stack with one shared ggml dependency and selectable whisper, parakeet, TTS, and audiogen engines. This port revision advances the source pin to qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp d5472eec (792b6892..d5472eec). It ships PR #158, which makes MiniMax-Music3 produce music instead of tonal noise: the runtime no longer honors the vestigial mm3.dit.output_negated GGUF flag that flipped a correct flow velocity, and the DiT condition is re-uploaded on every forward because the graph allocator recycles input blocks between computes (the resident upload left steps 1..N-1 on garbage conditioning). Replaying the official Diffusers prompt/codes/noise through the native pipeline now reproduces the official mix at 0.9993 time-domain audio correlation on CPU and GPU. The same PR adds MiniMax GPU execution (EngineOptions::device = cpu | gpu | auto; gpu fails creation without a usable GPU, auto falls back to CPU), the mm3-replay parity harness, and a model-backed quality regression. The window also carries PR #156 (IndicConformer multilingual CTC validated on Vulkan), PRs #159/#161 (Chatterbox and Supertonic CUDA engine paths; the speech-cpp[cuda] feature that exposes them is added by the TTS CUDA epic's own registry bump), and PR #160 (addon.node cmake-js 8.x, not built by this port). No ggml-speech bump required: the window is engine-side only and runs against ggml-speech 2026-08-18.

audiogen.description: Build the audiogen engine (ACE-Step music generation) from engines/audiogen. CMake package: find_package(audiogen-cpp CONFIG) + audiogen-cpp::audiogen-cpp.

coreml.description: Parakeet only: enable the Apple Core ML (Neural Engine) encoder sidecar (presence-driven at runtime; falls back to the ggml encoder when the .mlmodelc sidecar is absent).

metal.description: Enable Metal GPU acceleration for all enabled engines (macOS / iOS, via ggml-speech[metal]).

opencl.description: Enable OpenCL GPU acceleration for all enabled engines (Android / Adreno, via ggml-speech[opencl]).

parakeet.description: Build the Parakeet engine (NVIDIA FastConformer ASR: CTC / TDT / EOU, plus Sortformer diarization) from engines/parakeet. CMake package: find_package(qvac-parakeet CONFIG) + qvac::parakeet.

tts.description: Build the TTS engine collection from engines/tts: Resemble Chatterbox (Turbo + Multilingual), Supertonic, Fun-CosyVoice3, Parler-TTS, Audio8 and LavaSR speech enhancement, as one library. CMake package: find_package(tts-cpp CONFIG) + tts-cpp::tts-cpp.

vulkan.description: Enable Vulkan GPU acceleration for all enabled engines (Linux / Windows / Android; Apple platforms use the metal feature instead, via ggml-speech[vulkan]).

whisper.description: Build the whisper engine from third_party/whisper.cpp (upstream whisper.cpp with the QVAC delta; upstream's bundled parakeet is gated off). CMake package: find_package(whisper CONFIG) + whisper::whisper.
